CHERALATHAN B.N
Computer Science Student (Expected 2027) | Software Engineer | Full-Stack / Backend | AI-GenAI
cheralathannandha9098@gmail.com | 8668180041 | linkedin.com/in/cheralathan05 | github.com/cheralathan05
SUMMARY
B.E. Computer Science student (expected 2027) with hands-on experience building full-stack applications in React,
Next.js and Node.js, with PostgreSQL and MySQL backends. Completed a GenAI internship using the OpenAI API
(GPT-4, prompt engineering, embeddings). 70+ DSA problems solved on LeetCode; solid in OOP and DBMS.
EDUCATION
K.S.R. College of Engineering — B.E. Computer Science and Engineering 2023 – Expected 2027
CGPA: 7.50 / 10
Saru Matric Higher Secondary School — HSC 2023
Score: 70%
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Java, JavaScript, SQL, Python
Frontend: React.js, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Node.js, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Authentication
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
AI / GenAI: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI
Tools: Git, GitHub, Postman, VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA
Fundamentals: Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, DBMS
PROJECTS
Business OS — Business Management & Automation Platform github.com/cheralathan05/crm
• Business OS pulls CRM, tasks, and day-to-day operational data into one app instead of juggling separate tools for
each.
• Login and permissions decide who can see or edit what. I set up a few different roles (admin, manager, and so on)
and had to rework the permission checks more than once before they matched what I wanted.
• Backend is a set of REST APIs on top of MySQL. I added Redis to cache the handful of endpoints that got hit most,
mainly to cut down repeated database calls.
Tech Stack: React, Node.js, JavaScript, MySQL, REST APIs, Redis, Tailwind CSS
Nexus Browser — AI-Powered Desktop Browser github.com/cheralathan05/nexus-browser
• Built an AI-powered desktop browser combining web browsing, AI assistance, tab management, history,
downloads, and bookmarks in one workspace.
• Developed AI agents and workflows for webpage understanding, content extraction, task planning, automation,
retries, and approval-based actions.
• Implemented a Deep Research system using multiple LLM providers to search sources, analyze information,
cross-check results, and generate cited reports.
Tech Stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, Prisma, OpenAI SDK
EXPERIENCE
Generative AI Intern — One Yes Technology Pvt Ltd Jun 2025 (1 Month) | Remote
• Worked on the GPT-4 side of a few product features: tuning prompts and adding embeddings so responses were
more relevant to what users were asking.
• Also touched the REST API layer these features ran on, and added caching plus cut down on repeated model calls
to help bring latency down.
Cybersecurity Intern — Zero Touch Pvt Ltd Jul 2024 (1 Month) | India
• Ran threat analysis and vulnerability checks on a few systems. Wrote up what I found and flagged which issues
needed fixing first.
• Set up a couple of simulated attack scenarios in a lab environment and documented how well the
incident-response steps actually held up.

-- 1 of 1 --

Computer Science Student (Expected 2027) | Software Engineer | Full-Stack / Backend | AI-GenAI
cheralathannandha9098@gmail.com | 8668180041 | linkedin.com/in/cheralathan05 | github.com/cheralathan05
SUMMARY
B.E. Computer Science student (expected 2027) with hands-on experience building full-stack applications in React,
Next.js and Node.js, with PostgreSQL and MySQL backends. Completed a GenAI internship using the OpenAI API
(GPT-4, prompt engineering, embeddings). 70+ DSA problems solved on LeetCode; solid in OOP and DBMS.
EDUCATION
K.S.R. College of Engineering — B.E. Computer Science and Engineering 2023 – Expected 2027
CGPA: 7.50 / 10
Saru Matric Higher Secondary School — HSC 2023
Score: 70%
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Java, JavaScript, SQL, Python
Frontend: React.js, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Node.js, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Authentication
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
AI / GenAI: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI
Tools: Git, GitHub, Postman, VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA
Fundamentals: Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, DBMS
PROJECTS
Business OS — Business Management & Automation Platform github.com/cheralathan05/crm
• Business OS pulls CRM, tasks, and day-to-day operational data into one app instead of juggling separate tools for
each.
• Login and permissions decide who can see or edit what. I set up a few different roles (admin, manager, and so on)
and had to rework the permission checks more than once before they matched what I wanted.
• Backend is a set of REST APIs on top of MySQL. I added Redis to cache the handful of endpoints that got hit most,
mainly to cut down repeated database calls.
Tech Stack: React, Node.js, JavaScript, MySQL, REST APIs, Redis, Tailwind CSS
Nexus Browser — AI-Powered Desktop Browser github.com/cheralathan05/nexus-browser
• Built an AI-powered desktop browser combining web browsing, AI assistance, tab management, history,
downloads, and bookmarks in one workspace.
• Developed AI agents and workflows for webpage understanding, content extraction, task planning, automation,
retries, and approval-based actions.
• Implemented a Deep Research system using multiple LLM providers to search sources, analyze information,
cross-check results, and generate cited reports.
Tech Stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, Prisma, OpenAI SDK
EXPERIENCE
Generative AI Intern — One Yes Technology Pvt Ltd Jun 2025 (1 Month) | Remote
• Worked on the GPT-4 side of a few product features: tuning prompts and adding embeddings so responses were
more relevant to what users were asking.
• Also touched the REST API layer these features ran on, and added caching plus cut down on repeated model calls
to help bring latency down.
Cybersecurity Intern — Zero Touch Pvt Ltd Jul 2024 (1 Month) | India
• Ran threat analysis and vulnerability checks on a few systems. Wrote up what I found and flagged which issues
needed fixing first.
• Set up a couple of simulated attack scenarios in a lab environment and documented how well the
incident-response steps actually held up.

-- 1 of 1 --
